sources.sentence: After months of practice, the uniform felt like a second skin.

brief.meaningEn: Something worn so naturally and comfortably that it feels almost part of the person.
brief.meaningZh: 穿着自然舒服，感覺幾乎像自己身體一部分的東西。
brief.grammar: clothes/uniform feel(s) like a second skin; can extend to something very familiar in use.
brief.register: Common figurative expression, especially about clothing; comfort/familiarity is central here.
brief.boundaryZh: 不表示真的皮膚、不會磨損或適合所有場合，也不只指第二件衣服。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把習慣和舒適當成衣服永遠不用更換的保證。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用舒適和熟悉感說明衣物像身體一部分。

options.en: It felt natural and familiar to wear.
options.zh: 穿起來自然又熟悉。

options.en: It was being worn for the first time and felt awkward.
options.zh: 它是第一次穿，感覺彆扭。

options.en: It was guaranteed never to wear out.
options.zh: 它保證永遠不會磨損。

options.en: It was simply the second costume bought that day.
options.zh: 它只是當天買的第二套戲服。

listening.explanationZh: 多年穿着和輕便帶來自然感；second skin 是比喻，不是購買次序或耐用保證。
listening.en: After years of wearing it on stage, the light costume felt like a second skin.
listening.zh: 在舞台上穿了多年後，那套輕便戲服感覺自然得像自己身體的一部分。

reply.promptEn: Why do you keep choosing that jacket for practice?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼一直選那件外套來練習？

options.en: It feels like a second skin and never distracts me from moving.
options.zh: 它穿起來自然自在，不會令我分心，能專心活動。

options.en: It is light enough for the room we use.
options.zh: 它的厚薄適合我們用的房間。

options.en: I am used to where the pockets are.
options.zh: 我已習慣口袋的位置。

options.en: It is comfortable and easy to wash.
options.zh: 它舒服又容易洗。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都合理解釋選衣服；金句重點是自然舒適的感覺。

scene.promptZh: 樂手熟習一套合身演出服，活動時幾乎不再留意自己穿着它。哪句貼切？

options.en: The outfit feels like a second skin.
options.zh: 那套衣服穿起來自然得像身體一部分。

options.en: The outfit feels unfamiliar and restricts every movement.
options.zh: 那套衣服陌生，而且每個動作都受限制。

options.en: The outfit is only reserved for display and is never worn in practice.
options.zh: 那套衣服只保留作展示，從不在練習時穿。

scene.explanationZh: 合身、熟習而不分心，支持自然融入的比喻；不是活動受限，也不是只展示不用。

contrast.promptZh: 按本課衣着比喻，哪個情況最不像 a second skin？

options.en: A familiar outfit feels natural and comfortable in movement.
options.zh: 熟悉衣服活動時自然舒適。

options.en: A new stiff costume feels awkward and constantly draws the wearer’s attention.
options.zh: 僵硬的新戲服感覺彆扭，穿着者一直被它分心。

options.en: A performer barely notices a well-fitting costume after regular use.
options.zh: 演出者經常穿合身戲服，幾乎不再留意它。

contrast.explanationZh: 彆扭並一直分心，與自然得像自己一部分相反。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「像第二層皮膚是否表示衣服永遠不會破？」哪句準確？

options.en: No. Calling it a second skin describes comfort and familiarity, not how long the fabric will last.
options.zh: 不是。說它像第二層皮膚，是形容舒適和熟悉，不是布料能用多久。

options.en: Postpone repairing the worn seam because the jacket still feels familiar.
options.zh: 因為外套仍然熟悉，就押後修補磨損接縫。

options.en: Treat the comfortable feel as evidence that the fabric will last through another long trip.
options.zh: 把舒適感當成布料足以應付另一次長途旅行的證據。

dialogue.explanationZh: 第二層皮膚形容舒適及熟悉，不是耐用保證；仍要按磨損情況修補及評估布料。

speaking.en: The familiar uniform felt like a second skin.
speaking.zh: 熟悉的制服穿起來自然得像身體一部分。
speaking.promptZh: 你穿了很久的合身制服，感覺自然自在。先聽，再自己說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你練舞常穿一件輕便上衣，現在轉身和伸展都不覺得它礙事。用一至兩句英文形容舒適熟悉感。

examples.en: My practice top feels like a second skin after months of dancing in it. I can turn and stretch without noticing the fabric.
examples.zh: 穿它練舞數月後，我的練習上衣自然得像身體一部分。我轉身伸展時，幾乎不留意布料。

examples.en: The light top has become a second skin for me during practice. It is familiar and lets me move comfortably.
examples.zh: 練習時，那件輕便上衣對我來說已像身體一部分。它熟悉，也讓我自在活動。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以自然舒適活動作依據，不用實際皮膚、數目次序或永不磨損來解釋。

takeaways.en: Her favourite training top feels like a second skin.
takeaways.zh: 她最喜歡的訓練上衣穿起來自然得像身體一部分。

takeaways.en: After regular use, the costume became a second skin.
takeaways.zh: 經常穿着後，那套戲服變得像身體一部分。

sources.sentence: A clever design will not carry the day if it breaks quickly.

brief.meaningEn: Win or be the decisive factor in securing a result.
brief.meaningZh: 取勝，或成為促成結果的決定因素。
brief.grammar: an argument/design/evidence carries the day; past carried the day.
brief.register: Established, slightly formal idiom; common in discussion of arguments or decisions.
brief.boundaryZh: 要有勝出或決定結果的作用，不只是引起注意；不一定指整天。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把有吸引力但未影響決定的特點當成已致勝。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出最後讓方案獲選或論點獲接納的因素。

listening.promptZh: 實用布局起了甚麼作用？

options.en: It was decisive in winning support.
options.zh: 它對贏得支持起決定作用。

options.en: It was noticed but had no effect on the decision.
options.zh: 它被留意，但沒有影響決定。

options.en: It delayed the vote without producing any result.
options.zh: 它拖延投票，沒有產生結果。

options.en: It was rejected in favour of appearance alone.
options.zh: 它被否決，最後只按外觀選擇。

listening.explanationZh: won support 已交代結果，carried the day 強調致勝作用；不是只被看見。
listening.en: Several designs looked attractive, but the practical layout carried the day and won the committee’s support.
listening.zh: 幾個設計都吸引，但實用的布局成了致勝關鍵，贏得委員會支持。

reply.promptEn: What persuaded the panel to choose your proposal?
reply.promptZh: 甚麼說服評審選你的建議？

options.en: The clear evidence carried the day.
options.zh: 清楚的證據成了致勝關鍵。

options.en: We showed how the plan would fit the available budget.
options.zh: 我們展示計劃怎樣配合現有預算。

options.en: Our examples answered their main concern.
options.zh: 我們的例子回應了他們的主要疑慮。

options.en: The trial results gave them confidence in the approach.
options.zh: 試行結果令他們對方法有信心。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都解釋已獲選的原因；金句概括清楚證據起了決定作用。

scene.promptZh: 兩個隊伍辯論接近，最後有來源支持的論證說服評審，讓其中一隊勝出。哪句貼切？

options.en: The well-supported argument carried the day.
options.zh: 有充分支持的論證成了致勝關鍵。

options.en: The argument was never heard by the judges.
options.zh: 評審從未聽到那個論證。

options.en: The argument had no influence on the result.
options.zh: 那個論證對結果毫無影響。

scene.explanationZh: 說服評審且促成勝出，是本課決定結果的意思。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況還不宜說 carried the day？

options.en: A decisive argument wins enough support for the proposal to pass.
options.zh: 決定性的論證贏得足夠支持，使建議通過。

options.en: A feature attracts some attention, but the decision is still pending and its influence is unknown.
options.zh: 一項特點引起部分注意，但決定未作出，影響也未明。

options.en: A tested practical benefit secures the final choice.
options.zh: 經測試的實際好處促成最後選擇。

contrast.explanationZh: 只吸引注意而未有結果，不足以宣稱已成致勝因素。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「簡報設計漂亮就一定勝出吧？」哪句最準確？

options.en: Design may help, but it may not carry the day if the proposal fails to address the main need.
options.zh: 設計可能有幫助，但若建議沒有回應主要需要，它未必能成致勝關鍵。

options.en: A striking design guarantees that no evidence will be needed.
options.zh: 搶眼設計保證不用任何證據。

options.en: If the slides attract attention, the panel has already accepted the plan.
options.zh: 只要投影片吸引注意，評審就已接受計劃。

dialogue.explanationZh: 區分有利特點與決定結果，並指出主要需要仍重要。

speaking.en: The evidence carried the day in the final discussion.
speaking.zh: 最後討論中，證據成了致勝關鍵。
speaking.promptZh: 你想說明最後說服大家的是證據。先聽，再自己說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：小組比較兩個籌款方案，最後因其中一個有清楚成本和試行結果而獲選。用一至兩句英文說明致勝因素。

examples.en: The clear budget and trial results carried the day. They persuaded the group to choose our fundraising plan.
examples.zh: 清楚預算和試行結果成了致勝關鍵。它們說服小組選我們的籌款方案。

examples.en: Our practical evidence carried the day because it answered the group’s worries about cost. The plan won their support.
examples.zh: 我們的實際證據成了致勝關鍵，因為它回應了小組對成本的疑慮。計劃獲得了支持。

writing.selfCheckZh: 指出證據促成已作出的選擇，不只是引起注意或未決定的希望。

takeaways.en: A strong argument carried the day.
takeaways.zh: 有力論證成了致勝關鍵。

takeaways.en: Good looks alone may not carry the day.
takeaways.zh: 單靠好看未必能取勝。

sources.sentence: A bright coat can make a statement.

brief.meaningEn: Express an attitude, identity or message clearly through an action or style.
brief.meaningZh: 透過行動或風格鮮明表達態度、身分或訊息。
brief.grammar: make a statement with/through + choice; in this lesson expressive style/action, not formal testimony.
brief.register: Common figurative style and social-action expression.
brief.boundaryZh: 引人注意不代表人人解讀相同或一定同意；本課不是正式口供。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把表達態度與取得認同當成同一結果。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體選擇說明想表達的訊息，保留觀眾反應不同。

options.en: Use their clothing choice to communicate a message.
options.zh: 用衣着選擇傳達訊息。

options.en: Guarantee that every observer agreed with them.
options.zh: 保證每個看見的人都同意。

options.en: Give a formal account of an accident to the police.
options.zh: 向警方正式交代意外經過。

options.en: Avoid communicating any view about waste.
options.zh: 避免傳達任何有關浪費的看法。

listening.explanationZh: about reducing waste 指明衣着要傳達的態度；不是正式口供或認同保證。
listening.en: The team wore repaired clothes to make a statement about reducing waste.
listening.zh: 團隊穿修補過的衣服，鮮明表達減少浪費的態度。

reply.promptEn: Why did the club choose reusable decorations for the exhibition?
reply.promptZh: 學會為甚麼選可重用裝飾來辦展覽？

options.en: We wanted to make a statement about using fewer disposable materials.
options.zh: 我們想鮮明表達減少用即棄材料的態度。

options.en: We can use them again at the next event.
options.zh: 下次活動可以再用。

options.en: The materials fitted the theme of the exhibition.
options.zh: 材料配合展覽主題。

options.en: Making them together gave members a useful creative task.
options.zh: 一起製作讓組員有一項有用的創作任務。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都合理解釋選擇；金句重點是透過選擇表達立場。

scene.promptZh: 一名設計師刻意用回收布料製作展品，並解釋希望大家思考浪費。哪句貼切？

options.en: She is making a statement through her choice of materials.
options.zh: 她正透過選材鮮明表達態度。

options.en: She is trying to hide every view she holds about waste.
options.zh: 她正嘗試隱藏對浪費的所有看法。

options.en: Her choice proves all viewers have accepted her message.
options.zh: 她的選擇證明所有觀眾已接受訊息。

scene.explanationZh: 有意選材並說明訊息，符合表達態度；表達不等於人人接受。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個推論不宜由 make a statement 的本課意思作出？

options.en: A deliberate choice can communicate an attitude.
options.zh: 刻意選擇可以傳達態度。

options.en: Observers may notice a message in the style or action.
options.zh: 觀眾可能留意到風格或行動中的訊息。

options.en: Every observer must understand and agree with exactly the same message.
options.zh: 每位觀眾必須理解並同意完全相同訊息。

contrast.explanationZh: 能表達訊息不代表解讀或認同一致，仍要看情境。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我想用海報風格表達態度，但怕不是人人明白。」哪句回應準確？

options.en: You can make a statement with the design and add a clear caption to explain what you mean.
options.zh: 你可以透過設計表達態度，再加清楚說明交代意思。

options.en: Use the bold style alone and leave viewers to guess which attitude you mean.
options.zh: 只用大膽風格，讓觀眾自行猜要表達哪種態度。

options.en: Publish the poster before testing whether classmates connect the design with your intended message.
options.zh: 未測試同學是否把設計與原定訊息連結，便發表海報。

dialogue.explanationZh: 設計可表達態度，清楚說明和試看可幫助理解；只靠風格讓人猜，或未測試便發表，都未處理不明白的顧慮。

speaking.en: The simple design makes a statement without using many words.
speaking.zh: 簡單設計不用很多文字，也能鮮明表達態度。
speaking.promptZh: 你想形容設計怎樣直接傳達訊息。先聽，再自己說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們用回收紙製作校慶佈置，希望表達珍惜資源，並加上簡短說明。用一至兩句英文說明目的。

examples.en: We want to make a statement about saving resources by using recycled paper. A short caption will explain our choice.
examples.zh: 我們想透過使用回收紙，表達珍惜資源的態度。簡短說明會解釋我們的選擇。

examples.en: The decorations make a statement through reused materials. We will tell visitors why we chose them without assuming everyone will agree.
examples.zh: 佈置透過重用材料表達態度。我們會告訴訪客為甚麼這樣選，不假定每人都同意。

writing.selfCheckZh: 指出選擇要傳達甚麼態度，再解釋做法；不需要保證所有人認同。

takeaways.en: A bold colour can make a statement.
takeaways.zh: 大膽顏色可以鮮明表達態度。

takeaways.en: The choice of materials made a statement about reducing waste.
takeaways.zh: 材料的選擇，表達了減少浪費的態度。

sources.sentence: A plain shirt can be dressed up or down.

brief.meaningEn: Style clothing to look more formal or more casual.
brief.meaningZh: 透過配搭，讓衣着看來較正式或較休閒。
brief.grammar: a shirt can be dressed up or down; dress up = make more formal; dress down = make more casual.
brief.register: Common clothing phrasal-verb pairing; this lesson is style, not reprimanding someone.
brief.boundaryZh: 改變整體配搭，不必改造衣服；仍要看場合，不是所有衣服都適合所有活動。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把正式休閒當成好壞，也不要把 dress down 的責罵意思混入本課。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用鞋、外套或配件說明同一衣物怎樣轉換風格。

options.en: It can look more formal or more casual with different items.
options.zh: 配不同單品，可以看來較正式或較休閒。

options.en: It can only be styled for a formal outfit.
options.zh: 它只能配搭成正式衣着。

options.en: It suits every event regardless of its rules.
options.zh: 無論活動要求，它都適合每個場合。

options.en: It can only be worn with jeans.
options.zh: 它只可以配牛仔褲穿。

listening.explanationZh: 長褲與牛仔褲提供正式及休閒兩種配搭，重點是風格轉換；不是只限其中一種，也不保證所有場合合適。
listening.en: This plain shirt can be dressed up or down, with smart trousers for dinner or jeans for a casual day.
listening.zh: 這件素色恤衫可配搭成正式或休閒：晚餐配挺身長褲，休閒日配牛仔褲。

reply.promptEn: Why do you like that simple dress for travelling?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼喜歡旅行時帶那條簡單裙？

options.en: It can be dressed up or down, so I can use it for different plans.
options.zh: 它可配搭成正式或休閒，配合不同安排。

options.en: It folds easily and does not take much space.
options.zh: 它容易摺，也不佔很多空間。

options.en: I can wear it with the shoes I already have.
options.zh: 我可以配已經有的鞋穿。

options.en: The fabric is comfortable in the weather I expect.
options.zh: 布料適合預期天氣，穿起來舒服。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都能解釋旅行選衣；金句談配搭多用性，不表示任何場合都一定適合。

scene.promptZh: 你用同一件外套配襯衫和皮鞋出席晚餐，也配T恤和波鞋散步。哪句貼切？

options.en: The jacket can be dressed up or down.
options.zh: 那件外套可配搭成正式或休閒。

options.en: The same outfit is worn unchanged at the dinner and on the walk.
options.zh: 晚餐及散步都穿同一套完全沒變的配搭。

options.en: The jacket can only work with one fixed outfit.
options.zh: 那件外套只配得上一套固定衣着。

scene.explanationZh: 同一外套透過襯衫、皮鞋或 T 恤、波鞋改正式程度；不是整套原封不動，也不只配一套。

contrast.promptZh: 按本課衣着意思，哪個說法不合適？

options.en: Accessories can change how formal an outfit looks.
options.zh: 配件可以改變一套衣着看來多正式。

options.en: The same item may work in more than one style.
options.zh: 同一件衣物可能適合多種風格。

options.en: An item that can be dressed up or down is automatically suitable for every occasion.
options.zh: 可配搭成正式或休閒的衣物，自動適合所有場合。

contrast.explanationZh: 有配搭彈性不代表不用查看場合要求；不是無限制通用。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「這件外套可變正式或休閒，那去典禮一定合適？」哪句準確？

options.en: It can be dressed up or down, but we should still check the event’s dress code.
options.zh: 它可以配搭成正式或休閒，但我們仍應查看活動衣着要求。

options.en: Keep the casual trainers and assume the jacket makes them acceptable at this ceremony.
options.zh: 保留休閒波鞋，假設有外套就適合這次典禮。

options.en: Change the scarf and stop checking whether the ceremony requires formal shoes.
options.zh: 換一條圍巾，便不再查典禮是否要求正式鞋履。

dialogue.explanationZh: 配搭可改正式程度，但典禮可能有具體鞋履要求，須查清而非只改圍巾或假設外套足夠。

speaking.en: A simple shirt can be dressed up or down with different accessories.
speaking.zh: 簡單恤衫可以用不同配件搭成正式或休閒風格。
speaking.promptZh: 你想解釋同一件衣物怎樣有不同風格。先聽，再自己說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你想旅行少帶衣服，用同一件素色恤衫配長褲吃晚餐、配牛仔褲觀光。用一至兩句英文說明彈性，並提及先查晚餐場合要求。

examples.en: My plain shirt can be dressed up or down with trousers or jeans. I will still check the restaurant’s dress code.
examples.zh: 我的素色恤衫可配長褲或牛仔褲，搭成正式或休閒。我仍會查看餐廳衣着要求。

examples.en: The shirt can be dressed up or down, which helps me pack less. I can wear smart trousers for dinner if they meet the venue’s requirements.
examples.zh: 恤衫可搭成正式或休閒，讓我少帶衣物。如果符合場地要求，我可以晚餐時配較正式的長褲。

writing.selfCheckZh: 說明同一衣物的兩種配搭並保留場合核對；不要把多用性寫成所有場合通用。

takeaways.en: This simple dress can be dressed up or down.
takeaways.zh: 這條簡單裙可配搭成正式或休閒。

takeaways.en: The jacket can be dressed up or down with a change of shoes.
takeaways.zh: 換一雙鞋，那件外套便可配搭成正式或休閒。

sources.sentence: She chose the gift with both the head and the heart.
sources.expression: with both the head and the heart

brief.meaningEn: Use practical judgment and personal feelings together in a decision.
brief.meaningZh: 作決定時，同時運用實際判斷和個人感受。
brief.grammar: choose/decide with both head and heart; with both my head and my heart; body-part metaphor.
brief.register: Transparent figurative wording; not a claim that the organs make independent decisions.
brief.boundaryZh: 考慮兩面不代表剛好各半、沒有取捨或一定選對。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把有心意當成不用查預算，也不要把理性當成完全不顧感受。
brief.outcomeZh: 能在具體選擇中說明實際條件與情感需要如何一起考慮。

options.en: Personal care and a practical financial limit together.
options.zh: 同時考慮對人的心意和實際預算限制。

options.en: Only the price, with no attention to the recipient.
options.zh: 只看價錢，不理收禮者。

options.en: Only an impulse, without considering affordability.
options.zh: 只憑衝動，不考慮負擔能力。

options.en: A guarantee that the recipient would prefer it to every other gift.
options.zh: 保證收禮者會比所有其他禮物更喜歡它。

listening.explanationZh: 興趣反映心意，預算反映實際判斷；兩者一起不保證對方必定最喜歡。
listening.en: I chose the gift with both my head and my heart: it suited her interests and stayed within my budget.
listening.zh: 我選禮物時兼顧理性和心意：既配合她的興趣，也在預算之內。

reply.promptEn: How will you choose between the two volunteer roles?
reply.promptZh: 你會怎樣在兩個義工崗位之間選擇？

options.en: I will decide with both head and heart, considering the work I care about and the time I can give.
options.zh: 我會兼顧理性與心意，考慮重視的工作和能付出的時間。

options.en: I will check which role fits my timetable.
options.zh: 我會查看哪個崗位配合時間表。

options.en: I will ask where my skills could be useful.
options.zh: 我會問哪些地方可用到我的技能。

options.en: I will think about which cause matters most to me.
options.zh: 我會想哪個公益方向對我最重要。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都提出合理選擇方法；金句明確結合實際時間與個人重視的事。

scene.promptZh: 你選課時既看自己熱愛的內容，也查學費和能否出席。哪句貼切？

options.en: I am choosing with both my head and my heart.
options.zh: 我正兼顧理性與心意作選擇。

options.en: I am ignoring every practical condition.
options.zh: 我正忽略所有實際條件。

options.en: I am choosing only the lowest price without considering interest.
options.zh: 我只選最低價，不考慮興趣。

scene.explanationZh: 興趣與費用、時間同時被考慮，正是本課兩面結合的意思。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況不符合 with both head and heart？

options.en: Checking costs while considering what matters personally.
options.zh: 查費用，同時考慮自己重視甚麼。

options.en: Choosing solely on impulse while refusing to check an unaffordable cost.
options.zh: 只憑衝動選擇，拒絕查負擔不起的費用。

options.en: Balancing a meaningful goal with the time available.
options.zh: 在有意義的目標與可用時間之間作平衡。

contrast.explanationZh: 明確拒絕實際判斷，只靠衝動，缺少兩面一起考慮。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「這個選擇很有心意，就不用看預算吧？」哪句合適？

options.en: We can choose with both head and heart by keeping the personal meaning and checking what we can afford.
options.zh: 我們可以保留心意，也核對負擔能力，兼顧理性與感受。

options.en: Choose the expensive book your friend loves before checking whether it fits the budget.
options.zh: 未查預算是否足夠，便選朋友喜歡的昂貴書本。

options.en: Buy the cheapest unrelated item and leave your friend’s interests out of the choice.
options.zh: 買最便宜但無關的物品，選擇時不考慮朋友興趣。

dialogue.explanationZh: 兼顧心意及負擔能力，不是只憑喜好買貴書，也不是只看最低價而忽略朋友興趣。

speaking.en: I want to decide with both head and heart.
speaking.zh: 我想兼顧理性與心意作決定。
speaking.promptZh: 你想在實際需要和重視的事之間作平衡。先聽，再自己說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你選送給好朋友的生日禮物，想配合他的閱讀興趣，也不超出自己的預算。用一至兩句英文說明選擇方法。

examples.en: I will choose the gift with both my head and my heart. A book he will enjoy can be thoughtful without costing more than I can afford.
examples.zh: 我會兼顧理性與心意選禮物。他會喜歡的書可以有心思，也不用超出我的負擔。

examples.en: Choosing with both head and heart means considering his interests and my budget. I will compare a few suitable books before buying.
examples.zh: 兼顧理性和心意選擇，就是考慮他的興趣和我的預算。購買前，我會比較幾本合適的書。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用閱讀興趣代表心意，以預算代表實際判斷；不要把兩面考慮當成結果一定完美。

takeaways.en: She chose with both head and heart.
takeaways.zh: 她兼顧理性與心意作選擇。

takeaways.en: You can decide with both your head and your heart while checking the practical details.
takeaways.zh: 你可以兼顧理性與感受作決定，同時核對實際細節。
